entities.description: Contains all outpatient RX data used by the outpatient pharmacy package. As the above indicates, this is the hub of the outpatient system.  It will easily be the largest pharmacy file in time and is pointed to very heavily. Deletion of an entry in this file must be handled VERY carefully and is not allowed if refills have been issued. Of particular interest is that essentially all the history pertaining to a particular Rx is contained in each Rx entry.

columns.name: AU_PRESCRIPTION_IEN
columns.description: Unique identifier for the AU_PRESCRIPTION file.

columns.name: RX_#
columns.description: This is the prescription number.

columns.name: ISSUE_DATE
columns.description: Date when doctor wrote prescription.

columns.name: PATIENT
columns.description: The patient receiving treatment.

columns.name: PATIENT_STATUS
columns.description: This field is used to show the status of the patient at the time the medication was filled.

columns.name: PROVIDER
columns.description: Doctor who wrote the prescription.

columns.name: CLINIC
columns.description: Clinic where treatment was given and prescription was written.

columns.name: DRUG
columns.description: The actual medication.

columns.name: TRADE_NAME
columns.description: Free Text that, if it exists, will replace the DRUG name on the RXlabel.

columns.name: QTY
columns.description: This field is used to show the amount of medication that was dispensed.

columns.name: DAYS_SUPPLY
columns.description: Enter a whole number between 1 and 365. The maximum upper limit is 365, but may be lower based on the maximum specified for the drug in this prescription. The maximum value for the  drug can be found in the DRUG file (#50) or the VA PRODUCT file (#50.68) for drugs matched to NDF.

columns.name: #_OF_REFILLS
columns.description: The number of refills allowed per prescription.

columns.name: SIG
columns.description: Enter the medication instruction for this prescription. Entries should be no longer than 200 total characters, including spaces, with no one set of characters longer than 32 characters in length.

columns.name: OERR_SIG
columns.description: This field is used to determined if the original medication instructionswas accepted.  This field for all Rxs entered prior v7 will be null orno.  This field is uneditable.

columns.name: ORDER_CONVERTED
columns.description: This field is used to indicate V7 order conversion complete to OERR.It's also used to indicate the updating of CPRS on expiration of the order.

columns.name: COPIES
columns.description: The number of copies made of the label for the prescription.

columns.name: MAIL_WINDOW
columns.description: Indicates if the medication will be picked up, mailed, sent electronicallyor given in house to the patient.

columns.name: REMARKS
columns.description: Any additional comments.

columns.name: ADMINISTERED_IN_CLINIC
columns.description: This indicates if the medication was administered in a clinic instead of being dispensed to the patient.

columns.name: ENTERED_BY
columns.description: This field will show who requested the rx.

columns.name: UNIT_PRICE_OF_DRUG
columns.description: Price per dispense unit.

columns.name: DIVISION
columns.description: Tells which Outpatient Pharmacy Division filledthe prescription.

columns.name: LOGIN_DATE
columns.description: The date the prescription was entered.

columns.name: FILL_DATE
columns.description: The date the prescription was filled.

columns.name: PHARMACIST
columns.description: This field is used to identify the pharmacist that filled the medicationrequest.

columns.name: LOT_#
columns.description: The vendor code for this product.  It is required to be onthe label if the medication is sent to a nursing home.

columns.name: DISPENSED_DATE
columns.description: This field will be used to show the actual date the medication was dispensed.

columns.name: EXPIRATION_DATE
columns.description: The date the medication expires.  This is required to be puton the labels of medication sent to a nursing home.

columns.name: CANCEL_DATE
columns.description: This date is used to indicate when the medication was cancelled.

columns.name: NDC
columns.description: This field is used for the National Drug Code.

columns.name: MANUFACTURER
columns.description: This field is used to enter the manufacturer of the drug issued.

columns.name: DRUG_EXPIRATION_DATE
columns.description: This date is used to show the expiration date of the medication.  The datereflects the manufacturer's expiration date, not the date the Rx can no longer be filled.

columns.name: GENERIC_PROVIDER
columns.description: This field is used to to show a generic provider.  A generic provider is aprovider of care to the patient outside of the VA.

columns.name: RELEASED_DATE_TIME
columns.description: This field is used to show the actual date and time the medication wasreleased for inventory purposes and copay billing if applicable.

columns.name: RETURNED_TO_STOCK
columns.description: This field is used to show when and if the medication was returned to stockbecause the patient did not pick up the meds or it was not mailed.

columns.name: REPRINT
columns.description: This field is used to determined if the original fill was reprinted afterbeing returned to stock.  If fill was returned to stock and reprintedthis fill will be re-released.

columns.name: BINGO_WAIT_TIME
columns.description: This field reflects, in minutes, the total wait time for bingo boardpurposes.

columns.name: SEVERITY
columns.description: This field is used to store the significant drug interactions encounteredby technicians during new/renew order entry.  The data will be stored inthe form of a string, i.e., 23,43,201.  Each number will represent the drug/drug interaction found in file #56.  Data is not added directlyby FileMan.

columns.name: AFFECTED_MEDICATION
columns.description: This field is used to store the active medication pointer values that isconsidered to be drug interactions.

columns.name: DRUG_ALLERGY_INDICATION
columns.description: This field is used to indicate if a drug allergy event occured.

columns.name: METHOD_OF_PICK-UP
columns.description: Enter any special instructions that should appear on mailing addressportion of the label, specifing where, or when the RX(s) should be picked up.

columns.name: ARCHIVED
columns.description: This field is used to indicate if the Rx has been archived.  Once theRx is marked to be archived and then actually saved to the archived deviceshould this field be populated.  This will later be used to determine ifthe Rx can be purged.

columns.name: FINISHING_PERSON
columns.description: This field is used to indicate the person who finished the order in Pharmacy.

columns.name: FILLING_PERSON
columns.description: The name of the pharmacist who scanned the barcode before filling themedication request.

columns.name: CHECKING_PHARMACIST
columns.description: The name of the pharmacist that checked the medication request.

columns.name: FINISH_DATE_TIME
columns.description: Date/time prescription is finished.

columns.name: PROVIDER_COMMENTS
columns.description: PROVIDER_COMMENTS

columns.name: PHARMACY_INSTRUCTIONS
columns.description: PHARMACY_INSTRUCTIONS

columns.name: PHARMACY_ORDERABLE_ITEM
columns.description: This is the Pharmacy Orderable Item associated with the drug.This data should not be entered by using File Manager.  If the Rx does nothave a Pharmacy Orderable Item entered check the drug for the RX.  If thedrug is missing an orderable item match the drug not the Rx.  Only matchingthe Rx will cause problems when renewing the Rx.

columns.name: PLACER_ORDER_#
columns.description: This is the CPRS entry number for this order.

columns.name: PREVIOUS_ORDER_#
columns.description: This field is used to indicate rx number renewed from

columns.name: FORWARD_ORDER_#
columns.description: This field is used to stored the pointer to the rx that was renewed.

columns.name: WAS_THE_PATIENT_COUNSELED
columns.description: This field indicates whether or not the patient received counselingabout the prescription.

columns.name: WAS_COUNSELING_UNDERSTOOD
columns.description: This field indicates whether or not the patient understood the counselingon the prescription, if the patient was counseled.

columns.name: TITRATION_DOSE_RX
columns.description: This is the Titration Dose Rx from which the corresponding Maintenance Dose Rx originated.

columns.name: MAINTENANCE_DOSE_RX
columns.description: This is the Maintenance Dose Rx that was created from the corresponding Titration Dose Rx.

columns.name: TITRATION_RX_FLAG
columns.description: This flag indicates whether the prescription is being dispensed as a Titration Dose. It is intended to identify a Titration Dose Rx without a corresponding Maintenance Dose Rx.

columns.name: DAW_CODE
columns.description: Dispensed As Written code. This information is used for electronic claim transmission to third party payers (insurance companies).

columns.name: RE-TRANSMIT_FLAG
columns.description: This field is used to indicate that a claim should be electronically re-transmitted to the 3rd party insurance. It will be primarily used by CMOP and local mail prescriptions.

columns.name: DATE_NDC_VALIDATED
columns.description: This field contains the date and time that the NDC was validated prior to release of the prescription fill.

columns.name: NDC_VALIDATED_BY
columns.description: This field will contain the user ID of the person who validated the NDCprior to release of the prescription fill.

columns.name: BILLING_ELIGIBILITY_INDICATOR
columns.description: This field is set when a prescription is third party insurance billableand will contain T for TRICARE, V for VETERAN or C for CHAMPVA.

columns.name: EPHARMACY_SUSPENSE_HOLD_DATE
columns.description: This field is defined when a host reject error is received as a result of an ePharmacy claims submission.  The prescription fill will be held on suspense until the next day.

columns.name: HOLD_REASON
columns.description: This field tells why the prescription was put on hold.

columns.name: HOLD_COMMENTS
columns.description: This field is used to enter brief comments on why the medication was placedon 'Hold' status.

columns.name: HOLD_DATE
columns.description: This field is used to indicate the date that a prescription was placed onhold.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: This field represents the current status of the prescription.

columns.name: DISCONTINUE_TYPE
columns.description: This field is used to distinguish what type of external discontinueaction occurred.

columns.name: LAST_DISPENSED_DATE
columns.description: This field contains the last fill date.

columns.name: NEXT_POSSIBLE_FILL
columns.description: This field contains the next possible fill date.

columns.name: PRIOR_FILL_DATE
columns.description: This field is used to indicate the last date the prescription was filled.The dates in this field will be the date of the last renew from aprevious rx, and any subsequent fills.

columns.name: PENDING_NEXT_POSSIBLE_FILLDATE
columns.description: This field is to contain the next possible filldate if the Rx was discontinued prior to the original label printing.  If the Rx is reinstatedthis date will be restored to field 102 (next possbile filldate).

columns.name: NEW_DRUG
columns.description: This field is used to enter a new drug.

columns.name: VERIFYING_PHARMACIST
columns.description: This field is used to show the pharmacist that verified the prescription

columns.name: COPAY_TRANSACTION_TYPE
columns.description: This field contains the internal entry number of the pointer to theIB Action Type file (#350.1).

columns.name: IB_NUMBER
columns.description: This field contains the internal entry number of the pointer to the Integrated Billing Action file (#350).

columns.name: COPAY_TYPE_AUDIT
columns.description: This field serves as an audit of the original copay status. It is notchanged or reset if the orignal status is changed.

columns.name: COPAY_EXCEEDING_CAP
columns.description: This field contains the internal entry number of the pointer to the IBCOPAY TRANSACTIONS file (#354.71).  There will only be data in this fieldif this Rx's copay exceeded the annual copay cap.

columns.name: DELETION_COMMENTS
columns.description: This field is used to enter comments on why a prescription was marked asdeleted.

columns.name: COSIGNING_PHYSICIAN
columns.description: This field identifies the cosigning physician for prescriptions written bya provider for whom a counter signature is required, for example a nursepractitioner.

columns.name: TYPE_OF_RX
columns.description: This field is used to indicate if the rx dispensed is a partial or normalprocess rx.  If partial medication was dispensed this will be equal to the entry number else the field will be equal to zero.

columns.name: POE_RX
columns.description: This field shall be set whenever a new/renew prescription is entered afterthe Pharmacy Ordering Enhancements software for Outpatient Pharmacy has beeninstalled.This field will set to 1 for all pre-POE Rxs during the install of PSO*7*46.

columns.name: ORIGINAL_QTY
columns.description: This field will hold the quantity that was filled for the original fillof the Rx.

columns.name: PATIENT_INSTRUCTIONS
columns.description: The text in this field shall be used for the Patient Instructions in theOutpatient Pharmacy package when entering orders, if the Dispense Drugselected is matched to a Pharmacy Orderable Item with patient instructions.

columns.name: OTHER_PATIENT_INSTRUCTIONS
columns.description: This field will be used to store the Other Language Patient Instructionswhen added.

columns.name: EXPANDED_PATIENT_INSTRUCTIONS
columns.description: This field will store the expanded patient instructions that are storedin the patient instruction field (#114) or the expanded patient instructionsfrom CPRS.

columns.name: SERVICE_CONNECTED
columns.description: During Outpatient Pharmacy order entry, a pharmacist may be asked if themedication being prescribed is for a service connected condition. Thisfield will store the pharmacist's response to this question. The value inthis field will be used to evaluate whether or not a copay should beapplied to the prescription. This value will also be used as a defaultshould this question be raised again during the life of the prescriptionwhen a prescription fill is being released, or as the default for thequestion upon renewal of the prescription through CPRS or OutpatientPharmacy.

columns.name: MILITARY_SEXUAL_TRAUMA
columns.description: During Outpatient Pharmacy order entry, if a veteran has been identifiedas having been treated for Military Sexual Trauma, the pharmacist may beasked to identify whether or not the medication prescribed is being usedto treat a condition related to Military Sexual Trauma. This field willstore the pharmacist's response to this question. The value in this fieldwill be used to evaluate whether or not a copay should be applied to theprescription. This value will also be used as a default should thisquestion be raised again during the life of the prescription when aprescription fill is being released, or as the default for the questionupon renewal of the prescription through CPRS or Outpatient Pharmacy.

columns.name: AGENT_ORANGE_EXPOSURE
columns.description: During Outpatient Pharmacy order entry, if a veteran has been identifiedas having been exposed to Agent Orange during Vietnam service, thepharmacist may be asked to identify whether or not the medicationprescribed is being used to treat a condition due to this exposure. Thisfield will store the pharmacist's response to this question. The value inthis field will be used to evaluate whether or not a copay should beapplied to the prescription. This value will also be used as a defaultshould this question be raised again during the life of the prescriptionwhen a prescription fill is being released, or as the default for thequestion upon renewal of the prescription through CPRS or OutpatientPharmacy.

columns.name: IONIZING_RADIATION_EXPOSURE
columns.description: During Outpatient Pharmacy order entry, if a veteran has been identifiedas having been exposed to ionizing radiation during military service, thepharmacist may be asked to identify whether or not the medicationprescribed is being used to treat a condition due to this exposure. Thisfield will store the pharmacist's response to this question. The value inthis field will be used to evaluate whether or not a copay should beapplied to the prescription. This value will also be used as a defaultshould this question be raised again during the life of the prescriptionwhen a prescription fill is being released, or as the default for thequestion upon renewal of the prescription through CPRS or OutpatientPharmacy.

columns.name: SOUTHWEST_ASIA_CONDITIONS
columns.description: During Outpatient Pharmacy order entry, if a veteran has been identifiedas having been exposed to Southwest Asia Conditions (formerly referred toas Environmental Contaminants), the pharmacist may be asked to identifywhether or not the medication prescribed is being used to treat acondition due to this exposure. This field will store the pharmacist'sresponse to this question. The value in this field will be used toevaluate whether or not a copay should be applied to the prescription.This value will also be used as a default should this question be raisedagain during the life of the prescription when a prescription fill isbeing released, or as the default for the question upon renewal of theprescription through CPRS or Outpatient Pharmacy.

columns.name: DDSTATUS
columns.description: This field will hold the status of the prescription at the time a date ofdeath was entered.

columns.name: DATE_OF_DEATH_HISTORY
columns.description: This field will be used to take a snapshot of the Rx at the time it wasdiscontinued due to a date of death being entered for the patient.This data will be used to restore the Rx to the state before the date ofdeath was entered.

columns.name: HEAD_AND_OR_NECK_CANCER
columns.description: During Outpatient Pharmacy order entry, if a veteran has been identifiedas having been treated for Head and/or Neck Cancer due to nose or throatradium treatments while in the military, the pharmacist may be asked toidentify whether or not the medication prescribed is being used to treatthis condition. This field will store the pharmacist's response to thisquestion. The value in this field will be used to evaluate whether or nota copay should be applied to the prescription. This value will also beused as a default should this question be raised again during the life ofthe prescription when a prescription fill is being released, or as thedefault for the question upon renewal of the prescription through CPRS orOutpatient Pharmacy.

columns.name: COMBAT_VETERAN
columns.description: During Outpatient Pharmacy order entry, a pharmacist may be asked if the medication being prescribed is for a condition related to Combat Services while in the military. This field will store the pharmacist's response tothis question. The value in this field will be used to evaluate whether ornot a copay should be applied to the prescription. This value will also beused as a default should this question be raised again during the life ofthe prescription.

columns.name: PROJ_112_SHAD
columns.description: During Outpatient Pharmacy order entry, a pharmacist may be asked if themedication being prescribed is for a condition related to PROJ 112/SHADwhile in the military. This field will store the pharmacist's response tothis question. The value in this field will be used to evaluate whether ornot a copay should be applied to the prescription. This value will also beused as a default should this question be raised again during the life ofthe prescription.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_PLACER_ORDER_NUMBER
columns.description: This field represents the external system order number of this order. Thisfield will only be populated if this order was originally received from anexternal system into Vista.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_APPLICATION
columns.description: This field represents the name of the external system from where the external order was received.

columns.name: PFSS_ACCOUNT_REFERENCE
columns.description: This is a reference number to an external medical billing system Account Number for the purposes of uniquely identifying prescription charges for 1st or 3rd party billing.

columns.name: PFSS_CHARGE_ID
columns.description: This is another unique identifier required when prescription charge messages are passed to the external billing system.

columns.name: LAST_DISPENSED_DATE_HOLDER
columns.description: This field is a holder for the last dispensed date.

columns.name: TPB_RX
columns.description: If this field is set to 'Yes', that indicates that this prescription has been created as part of the Transitional Pharmacy Benefit project. This field is controlled by the software.

columns.name: CLOZAPINE_DOSAGE_(MG_DAY)
columns.description: This is the total daily dosage of clozapine if this prescription isfor the drug clozapine.  This is used only for clozapine.

columns.name: WBC_RESULTS
columns.description: This is the results of the WBC test which was used to authorize theclozapine prescription. This will exist only for clozapine prescriptions.

columns.name: DATE_OF_WBC_TEST
columns.description: This is the date of the WBC test which authorized the clozapineprescription.  It is used only for clozapine prescriptions.

columns.name: ANC_RESULTS
columns.description: This is the results of the ANC test that was used to authorize theclozapine prescription. This will exist only for clozapine prescriptions.

columns.name: SIGNATURE_STATUS
columns.description: Digital Signature status indicator.

columns.name: BACKDOOR_SIGNATURE_STATUS
columns.description: This field indicates whether a controlled substance order, schedule (I-V),was not digitally signed but entered via backdoor.

columns.name: EXT_RX_NUMBER
columns.description: This is the External Rx number as migrated in this order to vxVistA.

columns.name: PRESCRIPTION_PAD_#
columns.description: This field is used to capture the Prescription Pad number when prescribingControlled Substances.

columns.name: SCANNED_CODE
columns.description: This the scanned barcode for the first fill for the prescription.                                 It is captured if a the user scans a barcode to select the NDC. Otherwise,it will be empty.

columns.name: RELEASED_BY
columns.description: RELEASED_BY

columns.name: HOSPITAL_COVERAGE
columns.description: This field is used to compute hospital coverage from MAS.

entities.description: Pointer to the CMOP Transmission file #550.2.

columns.name: AU_PRESCRIPTION_CMOP_EVENT_IEN
columns.description: Unique identifier for the AU_PRESCRIPTION_CMOP_EVENT file.

columns.name: AU_PRESCRIPTION_IEN
columns.description: FK to AU_PRESCRIPTION

columns.name: TRANSMISSION_NUMBER
columns.description: This the number of the transmission which contained this prescription.

columns.name: SEQUENCE_#
columns.description: This is the message number of the Rx when it was transmitted to the CMOP.

columns.name: RX_INDICATOR
columns.description: This is the fill number of the Rx.  A '0' indicates that it was anoriginal fill.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: The current status of the prescription fill for the Consolidated MailOutpatient Pharmacy.  A status of Transmitted means that the Rx has beentransmitted to the CMOP for processing.  A status of Dispensed means thatthe Rx has been filled and mailed by the CMOP.  A status of Retransmittedmeans that the original transmission with this Rx had to be retransmittedto the CMOP.  A status of Not Dispensed means that the vendor system wasnot able to fill the Rx.  If the status is Not Dispensed, the reason willbe in the Reason field.

columns.name: NDC_RECEIVED
columns.description: The National Drug Code (NDC) returned for this prescription.

columns.name: CANCELLED_DATE_TIME
columns.description: This is the date and time the Rx was cancelled at the CMOP.  If cancelled,the Rx was not filled.

columns.name: RESUBMIT_STATUS
columns.description: This field is used to track whether this fill has been resubmitted to theCMOP.  If the field contains 'yes' then the fill has been resubmitted andcannot be resubmitted again.

columns.name: CANCELLED_REASON
columns.description: This is the free text reason the Rx was not filled at the CMOP.

columns.name: DATE_SHIPPED
columns.description: The date/time the prescription was shipped to the patient from the CMOP.

columns.name: CARRIER
columns.description: The carrier responsible for shipping the prescription to the patient.

columns.name: PACKAGE_ID
columns.description: A unique identification code assigned by the non-DHCP system for trackingthe  prescription shipment.

columns.name: NDC_SENT
columns.description: The National Drug Code (NDC) sent for this prescription.

columns.name: FDA_MED_GUIDE_FILENAME
columns.description: This field contains the filename of the FDA Medication Guide for the drug in this prescription at the time the fill was transmitted to CMOP.

entities.description: This is the date when activity occurred.

columns.name: AU_PRESCRIPTION_COPAY_ACTIVITY_LOG_IEN
columns.description: Unique identifier for the AU_PRESCRIPTION_COPAY_ACTIVITY_LOG file.

columns.name: AU_PRESCRIPTION_IEN
columns.description: FK to AU_PRESCRIPTION

columns.name: COPAY_ACTIVITY_LOG
columns.description: This is the date when activity occurred.

columns.name: REASON
columns.description: What was done to cause the copay activity to occur.  'A' will indicatethat the Annual Copay Cap was reached for a patient whenthis prescription was released.  'R' will indicate that the prescription'scopay status was reset due to a patient eligibility, copay exemptionstatus change, etc.  'I' will indicate that a copay change was initiatedby the Integrated Billing application and not through the releasefunction. 'C' is for cancellation of existing copay charges. 'E' is copayedited, e.g. the Days Supply is changed.

columns.name: INITIATOR_OF_COPAY_ACTIVITY
columns.description: The name of the person responsible for the copay activity.

columns.name: RX_REFERENCE
columns.description: This field is used to indicate which fill corresponds to thecopay activity..

columns.name: COMMENT
columns.description: Additional information will be entered here to detail why the copayactivity occurred.

columns.name: OLD_VALUE
columns.description: This field is used to show the old copay status value for the prescriptionif the reason for the copay activity is set to 'R' 'Reset Copay Status'.

columns.name: NEW_VALUE
columns.description: This field is used to show the new copay status value for the prescriptionif the reason for the copay activity is set to 'R' 'Reset Copay Status'.

entities.description: This sub-file will contain the dispense units per dosage ordered, dosageordered, units, noun, duration and conjunction fields.

columns.name: AU_PRESCRIPTION_IEN

columns.name: DOSAGE_ORDERED
columns.description: This is a single dose of medication the patient will receive for this Rx order.

columns.name: DISPENSE_UNITS_PER_DOSE
columns.description: This is the number of Units (tablets, capsules, etc.) to be dispensedas a dose for this order.

columns.name: UNITS
columns.description: Unit of measure.  Pointer to the Drug Units file (50.607).

columns.name: NOUN
columns.description: These are the nouns that are associated with this Dosage form.  It will beused by the Outpatient Pharmacy software to build a SIG for an OE/RRorder.

columns.name: DURATION
columns.description: This is the length of time that a medication order should be given. If youenter a numeric value, Days will be assumed. You may also enter a numericvalue followed by a letter. The letters can be entered as 'M' for Minutes,'H' for Hours, 'D' for Days, 'W' for Weeks, 'L' for Months. THIS IS NOT DAYS SUPPLY!

columns.name: CONJUNCTION
columns.description: This code is used to help build a Possible Sig for a complex medicationdose.  This code usually expands to an 'and', a 'then', or an 'except'.

columns.name: ROUTE
columns.description: This is how the medication is taken, applied, or used.

columns.name: SCHEDULE
columns.description: This field is used to tell the patient how often the medication is to be used.

columns.name: VERB
columns.description: This verb will be used to describe how the medication will be taken/used.

columns.name: OTHER_LANGUAGE_DOSAGE
columns.description: This is a single dose of medication the patient will receive for this Rxorder.  Data should be entered into the field when the patient has anotherlanguage preference and there is a free-text of a local dosage entered.

columns.name: FREE_TEXT_DOSAGE
columns.description: A computed flag indicating if an ordered dosage is a free text entry.

columns.name: LABEL_COMMENT

columns.name: PRINTED_BY

columns.name: WARNING_LABEL_TYPE

columns.name: DEVICE
columns.description: This filed is used to show which printer the label printed on.

columns.name: FDA_MED_GUIDE_FILENAME

columns.name: MEDICATION_ROUTES
columns.description: This field contain possible medication routes.

columns.name: MED_ROUTE

columns.name: SERVICE_CONNECTED

columns.name: PICKUP_ROUTING

columns.name: REASON_ORDER_CREATED

columns.name: PREVIOUS_ORDER_#

columns.name: COMMENTS

columns.name: PRIORITY
columns.description: This field is used to indicate the urgency of the order.

columns.name: POSSIBLE_FILLDATE
columns.description: This field will be used to display the effective date of a discharge med orpass med.

columns.name: DATE_TIME_FLAGGED
columns.description: This is the date/time when this order was flagged.

columns.name: FLAGGED_BY
columns.description: This is the user who flagged this order.

columns.name: REASON_FOR_FLAG
columns.description: REASON_FOR_FLAG

columns.name: DATE_TIME_UNFLAGGED
columns.description: This is the date/time this order was unflagged.

columns.name: UNFLAGGED_BY
columns.description: This is the user who unflagged this order.

columns.name: REASON_FOR_UNFLAG
columns.description: This is the reason for unflagging this order, usually a response to the reason for flag.

columns.name: RELATED_INSTITUTION
columns.description: This is the Institution that the order was issued from.

columns.name: DAYS_SUPPLY
columns.description: Enter a whole number between 1 and 365. The maximum upper limit is 365, but may be lower based on the maximum specified for the drug in this pending order. The maximum value for the  drug can be found in the DRUG file (#50) or the VA PRODUCTfile (#50.68) for drugs matched to NDF.

columns.name: FLAG
columns.description: This field shall designate whether or not a prescription has been flaggedfor follow up with a provider.

columns.name: PRE-POE_ORDER
columns.description: This field will be used to identify pending orders entered before theinstallation of the Pharmacy Order Enhancement patch.  PSO*7*46.

columns.name: PATIENT_INSTRUCTIONS
columns.description: The text in this field shall be used for the Patient Instructions in theOutpatient Pharmacy package when entering orders, if the Dispense Drugselected is matched to a Pharmacy Orderable Item with patient instructions.

columns.name: PATIENT_INSTRUCTIONS_FLAG
columns.description: This field will be used to indicate for the provider wanted the patientinstructions included in the SIG.

columns.name: EXPANDED_PATIENT_INSTRUCTIONS
columns.description: This field will store the expanded patient instructions that are stored inthe patient instruction field (#114) or the expanded patient instructionsfrom CPRS.

columns.name: MILITARY_SEXUAL_TRAUMA
columns.description: During CPRS order entry, if a veteran has been identified as having beentreated for Military Sexual Trauma, the clinician will be asked toidentify whether or not the outpatient medication order being prescribedis being used to treat a condition related to Military Sexual Trauma. Thisfield will store the response that was entered for this question. Thisvalue will be used as the default value for the same prompt presented tothe pharmacist when finishing the medication order that was enteredthrough CPRS.

columns.name: AGENT_ORANGE_EXPOSURE
columns.description: During CPRS order entry, if a veteran has been identified as having beenexposed to Agent Orange during Vietnam service, the clinician will beasked to identify whether or not the outpatient medication orderprescribed is being used to treat a condition due to this exposure. Thisfield will store the response that was entered for this question. Thisvalue will be used as the default value for the same prompt presented tothe pharmacist when finishing the medication order that was enteredthrough CPRS.

columns.name: IONIZING_RADIATION_EXPOSURE
columns.description: During CPRS order entry, if a veteran has been identified as having beenexposed to ionizing radiation during military service, the clinician willbe asked to identify whether or not the outpatient medication orderprescribed is being used to treat a condition due to this exposure. Thisfield will store the response that was entered for this question. Thisvalue will be used as the default value for the same prompt presented tothe pharmacist when finishing the medication order that was enteredthrough CPRS.

columns.name: SOUTHWEST_ASIA_CONDITIONS
columns.description: During CPRS order entry, if a veteran has been identified as having beenexposed to Southwest Asia Conditions during the Persian Gulf War, theclinician will be asked to identify whether or not the outpatientmedication order prescribed is being used to treat a condition due to thisexposure. This field will store the response that was entered for thisquestion. This value will be used as the default value for the same promptpresented to the pharmacist when finishing the medication order that wasentered through CPRS.

columns.name: HEAD_AND_OR_NECK_CANCER
columns.description: During CPRS order entry, if a veteran has been identified as having beentreated for Head and/or Neck Cancer due to nose or throat radiumtreatments while in the military, the clinician will be asked to identifywhether or not the outpatient medication order prescribed is being used totreat this condition. This field will store the response that was enteredfor this question. This value will be used as the default value for thesame prompt presented to the pharmacist when finishing the medicationorder that was entered through CPRS.

columns.name: COMBAT_VETERAN
columns.description: During CPRS order entry, if a veteran has been identified as having been treated for a condition related to Combat Services, the clinician will be asked to identify whether or not the outpatient medication order beingprescribed is being used to treat a condition related to Combat Services.This field will store the response that was entered for this question.This value will be used as the default value for the same prompt presentedto the pharmacist when finishing the medication order that was enteredthrough CPRS.

columns.name: PROJ_112_SHAD
columns.description: During CPRS order entry, if a veteran has been identified as having beentreated for a condition related to PROJ 112/SHAD, the clinician will be asked to identify whether or not the outpatient medication order being prescribed is being used to treat a condition related to PROJ 112/SHAD. This field will store the response that was entered for this question.  This value will be used as the default value for the same prompt presentedto the pharmacist when finishing the medication order that was enteredthrough CPRS.

columns.name: DDSTATUS
columns.description: This field will hold the status of the pending order at the time a date ofdeath was entered.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_PLACER_ORDER_NUMBER
columns.description: This field represents the external system order number of this order. Thisfield will only be populated if this order was originally received from anexternal system into Vista.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_SYSTEM_ORDER_REPLACED
columns.description: This field will be set to 1 by the software when an external system ordernumber is successfully replaced by a Computerized Patient Record System(CPRS) order number.

columns.name: EXTERNAL_APPLICATION
columns.description: This field represents the name of the external system from where the external order was received.

columns.name: SIGNATURE_STATUS
columns.description: Digital Signature status indicator.

columns.name: DRUG_INCLUDED
columns.description: This field indicates CPRS included the dispense drug as part of the hashcalculation for digitally signed orders.

columns.name: BACKDATE
columns.description: This is the date that is used to replace the start date of the refill request when the request is issued.

columns.name: BACKDATED_ON
columns.description: This is when the backdate date was filed.

columns.name: BACKDATED_BY
columns.description: This is the user that filed the backdate.

columns.name: BACKDATE_JUSTIFICATION
columns.description: BACKDATE_JUSTIFICATION

columns.description: This fields usually contains the amount to be given as entered through CPRS.It can also possibly contain the Dose Form of the medication.

columns.name: SCHEDULE
columns.description: This is the schedule for the medication, as entered through CPRS.

columns.name: DURATION

columns.name: UNITS
columns.description: This is the unit of measure associated with the Dosage ordered. It is apointer to the DRUG UNITS File (#50.607).

columns.name: NOUN

columns.name: VERB
columns.description: This verb will be used to describe how the medication is taken/used.

entities.description: This multiple is used to store up to eight ICD-9 codes per prescriptionwith the first always being the primary diagnosis code and subsequent onesbeing secondary diagnosis codes.  Also stored in this multiple are all ofthe Service Connection (SC) and Environmental Indicators (EI) that directly relate to each ICD-9 code.  These SC/EI's are passed from CPRS inthis manner. This ICD-9/SC/EI relationship is necessary for 3rd PartyBilling. Current Copay functionality deals only with SC < 50% and only stores EI's when with this is true or not overridden in some way.  The new SC/EI fields allow for Outpatient Pharmacy to know if a prescription isSC 0-100%, to know all EI's that apply, and to know howthey relate to the ICD-9 code without affecting Copay functionality.
